idea-plugin.name: DevFlow - Java & Typing Academy
idea-plugin.description: Build typing fluency and Java understanding inside your IDE. Includes 24 Java lessons, active recall, daily score cards, a touch-typing academy, 12 Debug Dojo fixes, adaptive symbol practice, IntelliJ shortcut coaching and a typing handicap. Runs locally with no account, telemetry or source-code capture.

action.description: Open your daily challenge and Java learning path
